**The claim on the site**
Quote the sentence and name the slide it appears on.

**What you believe is correct**
Your version of the fact.

**Your source**
A primary source if possible — Apollo 13 Flight Journal, Mission Report
MSC-02680, the Cortright report, NASA SP-350, or similar. (Movie scenes and
secondhand retellings don't count — that's how "Failure is not an option"
almost snuck in.)
